title: Because There Is Love
author: Boby Borah
text:
As there is love
The autumn rain touches gently,
Rose blooms in greenary,
The night jasmine carries fragrance,
In two little words of love
Tears drop down from the eyes.

Tell me one thing
Are the aspirations lost?
Could the moonlit say
On the terror of darkmoon
Why stars fall silently ?

As there is love
I hear your name
From Sunshine too.
Do you know
Why Radha didn`t come
On that day when
The bird sang the songs!
A word of pout
Became a tune and
Had been flowing from
The downstream of the Kodam tree.
stanzas: In two little words of love
Tears drop down from the eyes.
The downstream of the Kodam tree.
